summary.text: The bill would protect cloud storage companies from lawsuits and criminal charges when they contract with law enforcement agencies to store child sexual abuse material for criminal investigations, as long as the companies act responsibly and don't engage in intentional misconduct or negligence. It would also require these vendors to follow cybersecurity and evidence storage standards for handling such sensitive material.
